critique: The crawling ochre beetle towing a torn paper scrap through fading ink stamps gives the sepia specimen sheet a wonderfully absurd, organic bureaucracy, while the sliding strata and rotated “RE—FILED” marks convincingly dissolve the image into a living archive. The glacial 96-second circuit, low-contrast earth palette, and tiny clerk risk making the central conceit nearly invisible; enlarging the beetle and punctuating its route with brighter slate or vermilion filing transformations would add needed boldness and immediate surprise.
